        scope:actor = { lyd_c3_player_actor_trigger = yes }

        scope:actor = {
            if = { limit = { lyd_c3_player_actor_trigger = yes } set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_teacher_requested value = scope:recipient } }

        scope:actor = {
            if = { limit = { var:lyd_c3_teacher_requested = scope:recipient } remove_variable = lyd_c3_teacher_requested }
